headline: Meta Q3 profit jumps threefold as revenue climbs
summary: Meta Platforms reported that its third-quarter profit jumped more than threefold as revenue climbed sharply.
why: Meta is one of the world's largest digital advertising and social media companies, influencing broader technology and advertising sector trends.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected revenue and profit growth improve the company's financial outlook.

why_moved: Exceeding revenue and profit estimates signals robust business performance, driving positive market reactions.
